title: Better bus services from Sunday 25 October
articleDescription: From Sunday 25 October 2026, new timetables will start for 68 bus routes across Melbourne.
articleContent:
From Sunday 25 October 2026, new timetables will start for 68 bus routes across Melbourne. 

Some routes will also get extra trips, later services or buses on public holidays for the first time (excluding Christmas Day and Good Friday).

The changes will better connect buses with train services following the opening of the Metro Tunnel. 

To plan your journey: 

  • Download the PTV App
  • Use the journey planner
  • or call 1800 800 007.
